caption: The drawing depicts a pair of flat shoes positioned diagonally on a plain, light-colored background. Each shoe is shown from a slightly above and side angle, with one shoe oriented closer to the top left and the other to the bottom right. The shoes have a closed, squared toe and a low-cut vamp. The exterior of each shoe is patterned with a repeated swirling motif in light and dark blue on a medium-blue base. The inner lining and insole of the shoes are depicted in shades of pink, with visible highlights and shadows indicating shine and depth. Along the edge of the vamp, just above the patterned exterior, there is a jagged, sawtooth design in a reddish color, possibly representing decorative trim or embroidery. The shoes cast faint gray shadows onto the background. The name "Lillian Causey" is faintly written in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Woman's Shoes
